name: Camp LEAD
city: Near Suttle Lake, west of Sisters, OR
what_you_do: A week-long camp for young people with disabilities. Work about 21 hours on outdoor jobs like trail work and fuels reduction. Afternoons and evenings are for camp activities, and the camp teaches LEAD leadership lessons.
who_can_apply: Young people ages 16 to 22 who have a disability. You must be able to do light physical work about 6 hours a day, with some accommodations.
pay_detail: $16 per hour. T-shirt, work shirt, safety gear, tools, camping equipment and food are provided.
duration: 1 week (Week 1: July 12 to 16, 2027. Week 2: July 19 to 23, 2027)
deadline_text: Applications are open for July 2027. The page says the deadline is in June but the day is not shown.
how_to_apply: Send in the online application and wait for staff to confirm. You hear after the application closes. Then you get sign-up papers. You go to a virtual orientation, with a parent or guardian if you are under 18.
notes: Campers must be dropped off and picked up at the camp area. Up to 8 campers may do 2 extra weeks with COYCC crews.
